decision: The package version is bumped to 1.2.0 for declared-binding context lookup, including grounded context --changed-files PATH [PATH ...], project-relative and project-absolute changed-file normalization, distance-0 context seeds from matched file-binding owners, deterministic multi-file seed ordering, no-match failure behavior, Markdown and JSON output support, include-bindings compatibility, focused documentation updates, and executable changed-file context coverage.
name: Release changed-file context lookup as 1.2.0
description: Documents the 1.2.0 version bump so declared-binding changed-file context lookup has a canonical Grounded owner.
